item.title: Be Strong and Courageous
item.description:
Read: Scripture Joshua 1:1–9 NIV

Tap or hover over the reference to read the full passage without leaving the page.

Joshua was facing something enormous. Moses had died, and after years of watching Moses lead Israel, Joshua was now responsible for leading the people into the land God had promised them. Thousands of people were looking to him, there were enemies ahead, and Joshua couldn’t possibly know exactly what was going to happen.

item.title: Starting Again — Family Devotions
item.description:
There are some things we know are important and yet still struggle to do consistently.

Reading the Bible has, at different points in my life, been one of those things. Family devotions have been another. I have ADHD, and consistency and discipline are things I’ve always struggled with. I can become deeply absorbed in something, build a routine around it and then, somehow, find that routine has disappeared. There have been periods when I’ve read Scripture regularly and periods when I’ve let it drift. In recent years the same has happened with sitting down regularly as a family to read the Bible and pray together.

item.title: When Things Change
item.description:
Read: Scripture Psalm 46:1–7 NIV

Tap or hover over the reference to read the full passage without leaving the page.

Change can be difficult. Sometimes it is not even the change itself that is hardest, but the uncertainty that comes with it. We might know how yesterday worked, but suddenly we are not quite sure what tomorrow will look like.

That can happen when we start somewhere new, perhaps a new school, class or group. We need to learn where we fit, who people are and how things work. But change can happen in familiar places too. Someone we know might begin behaving differently towards us. A friendship might feel different. Something that once seemed easy can suddenly become confusing, and we can find ourselves wondering what we are supposed to do next.
